gold: Richter's transformation presenting as penile ulcer (transformation of chronic lymphocytic leukemia to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma)
shortlist: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type

selector.rationale: The biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+, and PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement, supporting a diagnosis of B-cell lymphoma.

rejected.why: The presence of CD20+ and CD79a+ atypical lymphocytes does not support this diagnosis
